line.name: Davidoff Escurio 10th Anniversary Limited Edition 2025
line.description: A one-off limited-edition blend marking 10 years since Escurio's 2015 debut (the 2nd Black Label release). Site already lists 'Escurio' as a line - this uses a materially different blend (added Ecuadorian wrapper, Brazilian binder, bourbon-cask-aged filler) from the standard Escurio, so it is recorded as its own limited-edition entry rather than folded silently into the base line.
line.filler: Dominican and Brazilian, combined age 45 years; one Dominican filler aged in a bourbon cask
